reproducible_build.dxf: Byte-reproducible with the same parameters, source and library versions: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 plus fixed DXF metadata. Independent of the installed fonts.
reproducible_build.png: Reproducible only where the same font files and the same Pillow version resolve; the fonts actually used are recorded below.

render_environment.note: PNG bytes depend on these fonts; the DXF does not.

original_manifest.self_excluded: package_manifest.json is excluded to avoid a self-hash cycle.
